what_happened: (Q3) resolved affirmatively on the first pass: clause (a) of both violation languages is subsumed by clause (b) of the same automaton at position 0, because the bar-translation of a characteristic conjunction of same-direction-pure literals is a pure linear formula whose truth at the cut does not read the hypothetical-type transducer state. Purity (Lemma 3.1 of the source report) was the whole lever; no new machinery needed.

Two defects located in the source report en route, both independent of (Q3) but exposed by it: (D1) Finding 5.1's claim that the running past-type Pi_0 is determined by pt requires PastLits/FutLits to be closed under pure-past/pure-future subformulas of the bar-translations, which Finding 1.1's definition does not give; (D2) Claim 1-plus's consequent is stated as the unconditional bad-word formula while clause (b) can only deliver the conditional form of Lemma 7.3, so the Claim 1-plus/Claim 2-plus pairing is mismatched. Recorded in the report as incidental findings with repairs.
